issues.title: A 0-unrepaired-recalls VIN lookup can miss historic Saab recalls and completed work
issues.cause: NHTSA's VIN lookup typically excludes safety recalls over 15 years old, completed campaigns and non-safety coverage.
symptoms: NHTSA shows 0 unrepaired recalls on an older used Saab
Seller cannot provide recall service records
issues.diagnosis_summary: Verify historical year/model recall campaigns separately, secure manufacturer/authorized service VIN completion information if available, and document actual parts/repairs.
issues.correction_summary: Never mark a vehicle recall-clear from a negative public VIN lookup alone; keep unknown until individually verified.
limits: No actual campaign result or guarantee of ongoing parts availability

issues.title: SID service-reset status cannot establish actual maintenance history
issues.cause: Factory SID can be reset without performing service, and the displayed message can reset automatically after repeated presentation.
symptoms: No invoices for ATF, brake fluid, plugs or belt
issues.diagnosis_summary: Review maintenance documents, fluid identification and actual inspection; compare source-scoped US/CA service schedule to elapsed time and mileage.
issues.correction_summary: Treat unknown overdue maintenance as inspection/service work for the purchase budget, without assuming engine or transmission is healthy.
limits: Vehicle could have received undocumented work
Do not run a damaged nonrunning car to force SID reading

issues.title: Historic MY2008 9-5 occupant-protection A-pillar recall cannot be marked complete without VIN/repair record
issues.cause: Saab original FMVSS201 upper occupant-impact noncompliance led to campaign E080101 / NHTSA 08V160.
symptoms: Used vehicle lacks recall campaign invoice
NHTSA current VIN lookup omits historic repairs and may omit aged campaigns
issues.diagnosis_summary: Check original 08V160 campaign eligibility for VIN and request documented prior authorized installation of updated A-pillar trim.
issues.correction_summary: Refer unverified vehicle to qualified Saab/GM support; do not guess from trim appearance or mark complete using a model-year label.
limits: No 2026 inventory or remedy appointment established

issues.title: MY2006–09 Saab Takata airbag safety recall requires campaign/VIN verified service
issues.cause: Driver frontal airbag inflator rupture risk identified in original GM 16V063 safety recall.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Confirm exact VIN applicability and whether manufacturer records show completion; account for GM campaign 15041/15043 registration-history distinctions.
issues.correction_summary: Arrange authorized recall repair if applicable and outstanding; do not dismantle or attempt independent airbag exchange.
limits: No real candidate VIN status checked
No current participating shop, stock or coverage independently verified

issues.title: 9-3 convertible driver belt retractor is subject to different historical recall than sedan
issues.cause: Driver seatbelt retractor tensioning cable may break on MY2004–11 9-3 convertibles.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Identify actual body style and VIN, verify relevant USA 14V318 or Canadian 2014228 service completion before treating belt as safe.
issues.correction_summary: Use authorized service campaign process and actual part/VIN application, not generic NG9-3 replacement assumption.

issues.title: Conflicting MY2008 Saab US/CA original automatic-fluid change milestones
issues.cause: Separate factory US/CA maintenance pages disagree: printed 60,000-mile checklist includes an automatic fluid change; annual additional-work checklist states 70,000 miles/5 years.
symptoms: Past automatic transmission maintenance interval unverified
Two original source-listed change triggers disagree
issues.diagnosis_summary: Obtain actual gearbox type and original Saab MY2008 US/CA printed booklet and WIS edition/TSB before accepting a single service timing; record date and mileage of actual servicing.
issues.correction_summary: Preserve both source-scoped thresholds rather than replacing the prior 70k finding or guessing a normalized compromise.
limits: No gearbox fluid substitution or immediate repair authorized
